events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation found incorrect phone numbers for 31 overseas customers: the old CRM lacked country codes, and the new CRM assumed +1 for every number. Batches 4–10 would have the same problem. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they relied on affected numbers is unknown. Please coordinate an immediate warning to sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, and provide verified country codes/phone numbers plus approval to correct the 31 affected records. Recommend fixing the country-code handling before resuming the remaining 280 records. No phone corrections have been made.
